items.title: Every UI element is a named asset
items.detail:
Apply the rule across schemas/asset-types.json, the web and Android ports, the 39 starter assets and the conformance fixtures.

- Two tiers: element assets (button, slider, toggle, input, icon, label...) and parent assets (toolbar, menu, nav, app menu, dialog, container, window). A standalone element in a layout is its own named asset; groups only exist inside a parent asset.
- Namespaced ids for every asset (e.g. axf.button.save, axf.toolbar.editor); layouts and parents reference ids.
- Split instance (label, icon, action, state) from skin (style asset + theme tokens).
- Slots with type contracts in layout regions and parents; hot-swap and drag-and-drop = rebinding a slot to a compatible asset id.
- Kernel unchanged (open type registry).

items.title: Asset Designer plugin (no-code)
items.detail: No-code editors for nav menus, drawers, app menus, context menus, toolbars, layouts, style packs and color themes. Every asset validates against its schema before save. Adds a drawer asset type. Installed by default.

items.title: Asset Browser plugin
items.detail: Browse, preview, import, export and hot-swap assets across apps built on AXF. Installed by default.

items.title: Plugin manager + settings tabs for every app
items.detail: Every plugin gets a plugin-manager entry (info, enable/disable, view logs, settings). Plugins never ship their own settings screen; they add tabs to the app settings interface. Every app compiled by the build engine ships the settings interface and lib-settings.

items.title: Asset templates: 10+ per type + defaults
items.detail: At least 10 editable templates/boilerplates for every asset type the designer covers, plus a default asset per type.

items.title: Pending build list manager (console)
items.detail: Console view of this list: date added for unbuilt items, date built for built ones, sortable by status and date. Built on Opus at Brett's request.
